.review-overlay {

  display: none;

  position: fixed;

  inset: 0;

  background: rgba(13, 43, 51, 0.55);

}

  justify-content: center;

}



.review-modal {

  border-bottom: none;

}

  font-weight: 700;

}

  color: #1d2f35;

  font-weight: 700;

  text-align: left;

}

.review-row.review-total .review-value {

  font-size: 17px;

}



.review-modal-error {

  display: none;

  background: #fdecea;

  color: #b00020;

  border-radius: 10px;

  margin: 10px 18px 0;

  text-align: center;

  font-weight: bold;

  font-size: 14px;

}



.review-modal-actions {

  display: flex;

  gap: 10px;

  padding: 14px 18px 18px;

}



.review-modal-actions button {

  margin-top: 0;

  padding: 13px;

  font-size: 16px;

}

}

}

  border: 1px solid #dce3eb;

}

}

}

  border-color: #34a853;

}



.grade-result-box.pass .grade-value {

}



.grade-result-box.fail {

  background: #fdecea;

}

  display: block;

}

  <script>

  let students = [];

  let supervisorToken = '';

  let supervisorSession = null;

  let requestedStudentId = '';



  


  let isSaving = false;          

  let pendingData = null;        

  let pendingOpId = '';          

  let lastSavedSummary = null;



  const EMBEDDED_NAVIGATION_TICKET = "";

    const SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'studentExamAuthToken';

  const SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY = 'studentExamAuthSession';



  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    initializeSupervisorAuth();

  });



  function initializeSupervisorAuth() {

    const savedToken = sessionStorage.getItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY) || '';



    if (savedToken) {

      verifySupervisorToken(savedToken);

      return;

    }



    initializeFromNavigationTicket();

  }



  function verifySupervisorToken(token) {

    setAuthMessage('جاري التحقق من الجلسة...', false);



    google.script.run

      .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {

        if (response && response.ok && response.authenticated) {

          acceptSupervisorSession(token, response);

          return;

        }



        clearSupervisorSession();

        initializeFromNavigationTicket(response && response.message

          ? response.message

          : 'انتهت الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.');

      })

      .withFailureHandler(function () {

        clearSupervisorSession();

        initializeFromNavigationTicket(

          'تعذر التحقق من الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.'

        );

      })

      .securityVerifySupervisorSession(token);

  }



  function initializeFromNavigationTicket(fallbackMessage) {

    const embeddedTicket = String(EMBEDDED_NAVIGATION_TICKET || '').trim();

    if (embeddedTicket) {

      consumeNavigationTicket(embeddedTicket, fallbackMessage);

      return;

    }



    google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {

      const ticket =

        location && location.parameter ? String(location.parameter.ticket || '') : '';



      if (!ticket) {

        showAuthScreen(fallbackMessage || 'يلزم تسجيل الدخول من بوابة النظام.');

        return;

      }



      consumeNavigationTicket(ticket, fallbackMessage);

    });

  }



  function consumeNavigationTicket(ticket, fallbackMessage) {

    setAuthMessage('جاري فتح صفحة الاختبار...', false);

    google.script.run

      .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {

        if (

          response &&

          response.ok &&

          response.authenticated &&

          response.token

        ) {

          acceptSupervisorSession(response.token, response);

          return;

        }



        showAuthScreen(response && response.message

          ? response.message

          : (fallbackMessage || 'تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام.'));

      })

      .withFailureHandler(function () {

        showAuthScreen('تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام وحاول مرة أخرى.');

      })

      .authPortalConsumeNavigationTicket(ticket, 'direct');

  }



  function acceptSupervisorSession(token, response) {

    supervisorToken = token;

    supervisorSession = response;

    sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);

    sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify({

      displayName: response.displayName || response.name || response.identifier || '',

      role: response.role || ''

    }));

    showExamApp();

    readRequestedStudentThenLoad();

  }



  function readRequestedStudentThenLoad() {

    google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {

      requestedStudentId = location && location.parameter

        ? String(location.parameter.requestId || '').trim()

        : '';

      loadStudents();

    });

  }



  function supervisorLogout() {

    const token = supervisorToken;

    clearSupervisorSession();

    showAuthScreen('تم تسجيل الخروج.');



    if (token) {

      google.script.run

        .withSuccessHandler(goToLoggedOutPortal)

        .withFailureHandler(goToLoggedOutPortal)

        .authStaffPortalLogout(token);

      return;

    }



    goToLoggedOutPortal();

  }



  function goToLoggedOutPortal() {

    google.script.run

      .withSuccessHandler(function (url) { window.top.location.replace(url + '?page=admin&logout=1'); })

      .withFailureHandler(function () { window.top.location.href = '?page=admin&logout=1'; })

      .getSystemWebAppUrl();

  }



  function clearSupervisorSession() {

    supervisorToken = '';

    supervisorSession = null;

    students = [];

    sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);

    sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY);

    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}

    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}

    try { sessionStorage.removeItem('TDK_DATA_ENTRY_AUTH'); } catch (ignore) {}

  }



  function showAuthScreen(message) {

    document.getElementById('authScreen').classList.remove('hidden');

    document.getElementById('appContainer').classList.add('hidden');

    setAuthMessage(message || '', Boolean(message));

  }



  function showExamApp() {

    document.getElementById('authScreen').classList.add('hidden');

    document.getElementById('appContainer').classList.remove('hidden');

    document.getElementById('sessionName').textContent =

      supervisorSession && supervisorSession.displayName

        ? 'المستخدم: ' + supervisorSession.displayName

        : 'جلسة إدارة مفعّلة';

    setAuthMessage('', false);

  }



  function setAuthMessage(message, isError) {

    const element = document.getElementById('authMessage');

    element.textContent = message || '';

    element.classList.remove('error-message', 'success-message');

    if (message) {

      element.classList.add(isError ? 'error-message' : 'success-message');

    }

  }



  function goToPortal() {

    google.script.run

      .withSuccessHandler(function (url) {

        window.top.location.href = url + '?page=home';

      })

      .withFailureHandler(function () {

        setAuthMessage('تعذر فتح بوابة النظام. أعد فتح رابط Web App.', true);

      })

      .getSystemWebAppUrl();

  }



  function goBackSafely() {

  google.script.run

    .withSuccessHandler(function (url) {

      window.top.location.href = url + '?page=admin';

    })

    .withFailureHandler(function () {

      setAuthMessage(

        'تعذر الرجوع إلى صفحة المشرف. أعد المحاولة.',

        true

      );

    })

    .getSystemWebAppUrl();

}



  function isSupervisorSessionError(message) {

    const text = String(message || '');

    return (

      text.indexOf('انتهت جلسة المشرف') !== -1 ||

      text.indexOf('لم يتم تسجيل الدخول') !== -1 ||

      text.indexOf('ليس لديك صلاحية') !== -1

    );

  }



  function handleSupervisorApiFailure(error, fallbackMessage) {

    const message = error && error.message

      ? toFriendlyErrorMessage(error.message)

      : fallbackMessage;



    if (isSupervisorSessionError(message)) {

      clearSupervisorSession();

      showAuthScreen();

      setAuthMessage('انتهت الجلسة. سجّل الدخول من جديد.', true);

      return true;

    }



    return false;

  }



  function loadStudents() {

    const select = document.getElementById('studentSelect');



    select.disabled = true;

    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">جارٍ تحميل الطلاب...</option>';



    google.script.run

      .withSuccessHandler(function (list) {

        students = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];

        select.disabled = false;

        renderStudentOptions(students, false);

        renderPendingStudents();

        if (requestedStudentId) {

          selectStudentForDirectTest(requestedStudentId);

          requestedStudentId = '';

        }

      })

      .withFailureHandler(function (error) {

        students = [];

  function normalizeDigitsClient(text) {

    return String(text || '')

      .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function (digit) {

        return String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(digit));

      })

      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function (digit) {

      })

      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

  }

  function validateGrade(input, maximum) {

    if (input.value === '') {

      calculateTotal();

      return;

    }



    let value = Number(input.value);



    if (isNaN(value) || value < 0) {

      value = 0;

    }



    if (value > maximum) {

      value = maximum;

    }



    input.value = value;

    calculateTotal();

  }



  function isValidScore(value, maximum) {

    if (value === '') return false;



    const number = Number(value);



    return (

      !isNaN(number) &&

      number >= 0 &&

      number <= maximum

    );

  }



  function getScore(id) {

    const value = document.getElementById(id).value;

    return value === '' ? 0 : Number(value);

  }



  function calculateTotal() {

    const total =

      getScore('q1') +

      getScore('q2') +

      getScore('q3') +

      getScore('q4') +

      getScore('tajweed') +

      getScore('performance');



    document.getElementById('degree').value = total;

    updateGradeDisplay();

  }

      minus.addEventListener('click',function(){change(-0.5)}); plus.addEventListener('click',function(){change(0.5)});
